d: A baby is a very young child or animal that cannot yet walk or talk.
If you go back, you return to a place where you were before.
Your background is the kind of family, education, and experience you have.
If something is bad, it is unpleasant, harmful, or of very low quality.
A bag is a container made of paper, plastic, or cloth used for carrying things.
When you bake, you cook food like bread or cakes inside an oven.
Balance is the ability to remain steady without falling over.
A ball is a round object that you kick, throw, or hit in a game.
If you ban something, you officially state that it is not allowed.
A band is a group of musicians who play modern music together.
A bank is a business that keeps money safe for people and companies.
A bar is a place where you can buy and drink alcoholic beverages.
If a surface is bare, it has no covering or nothing on it.
If you can barely do something, you can only just do it, with great difficulty.
The base of something is its lowest edge or the part it rests on.
Something that is basic forms the most important or necessary part of something.
You use basically when you are describing the most important part of a situation.
The basis of something is the main idea or reason that it is built upon.
A basket is a container made of woven materials like wood or plastic.
A bat is a piece of wood used to hit the ball in games like baseball.
A bath is the act of washing your body while sitting in a tub of water.
A bathroom is a room containing a toilet and a place to wash yourself.
A battery is an object that provides electricity for things like phones and toys.
A battle is a violent fight between groups of people, usually soldiers.
You use 'be' to describe someone or something, or to say what they are doing.
A beach is an area of sand or stones right next to the ocean.
A bean is a seed that you can eat, often growing in long pods.
If you can bear something, you can accept or handle a difficult situation.
If you beat someone in a game, you win against them.
If someone or something is beautiful, they are extremely attractive to look at.
Beauty is the quality of being very physically attractive or pleasing.
You use because when you are giving the reason for something.
If you become something, you change and start to be that thing.
A bed is a piece of furniture that you lie on to sleep.
A bedroom is a room in a house where people sleep.
Beef is the meat that comes from a cow.
Beer is an alcoholic drink made from grain and hops.
If something happens before another event, it happens earlier in time.
When you begin something, you start doing it.
The beginning of an event is the time when it starts.
The way you behave is the way you act and do things around others.
Behavior is the way a person or animal acts in a particular situation.
If you are behind a thing, you are at the back of it.
A being is any living creature, such as a human or an animal.
A belief is a strong feeling that something is definitely true or real.
If you believe something, you think it is true even without proof.
A bell is a metal object shaped like a cup that rings when it is hit.
If something belongs to you, you are the owner of it.
If something is below you, it is in a lower position than you.
A belt is a strip of leather or cloth that you wear around your waist.
A bench is a long, hard seat for two or more people, often found in parks.
When you bend something, you force it out of a straight line into a curve.
If something is beneath another thing, it is directly under it.
A benefit is a good or helpful effect that something has.
If you sit beside someone, you sit directly next to them.
You use besides to mean 'in addition to' or 'other than'.
The best thing is the one that is better than all the others.
If you bet money on a game, you risk losing it if you guess the wrong winner.
If one thing is better than another, it is of higher quality or more useful.
If you are between two things, they are on opposite sides of you.
If something is beyond a place, it is on the other side of it and further away.
A bicycle is a vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing the pedals.
If something is big, it is large in physical size or amount.
A bike is a casual word for a bicycle or a motorcycle.
A bill is a printed piece of paper showing how much money you owe.
A billion is the number 1,000,000,000.
If you bind things together, you tie them tightly with a rope or string.
A bird is an animal with feathers and wings that usually knows how to fly.
Birth is the time when a baby comes out of its mother's body.
Your birthday is the anniversary of the day you were born.
A bit of something is a very small amount or piece of it.
When you bite something, you cut into it using your teeth.
A bitter taste is strong and sharp, not sweet at all.
Black is the darkest possible color, like the color of the night sky.
A blade is the flat, sharp metal part of a knife or sword.
If you blame someone, you say that they are responsible for a mistake or crime.
If a piece of paper is blank, it has no writing or marks on it.
Someone who is blind is completely unable to see.
A block is a solid piece of wood or stone with flat sides.
Blood is the red liquid that pumps through your heart and body.
When the wind blows, the air is moving quickly outside.
Blue is the color of the sky on a sunny, clear day.
A board is a flat piece of wood or plastic used for a specific purpose.
A boat is a small vehicle used for traveling across water.
Your body is your entire physical self, including your head, arms, and legs.
When you boil a liquid, you heat it until bubbles form and turn to steam.
A bomb is a dangerous weapon designed to explode and cause damage.
A bond is a strong connection or feeling of friendship between people.
A bone is one of the hard, white pieces that make up a skeleton.
A book is a set of printed pages fastened inside a cover for reading.
A boot is a type of heavy shoe that covers your foot and ankle.
A border is the official dividing line between two different countries.
If someone bores you, they talk so much that you lose interest and feel tired.
If you are bored, you feel tired and unhappy because you have nothing to do.
If something is boring, it is not interesting or exciting at all.
When a baby is born, it comes out of its mother and begins its life.
If you borrow something, you use it for a while and promise to return it.
Your boss is the person in charge of you at your workplace.
When you bow, you bend your head or body forward as a sign of respect.
A bow is a knot with two loops and two loose ends, often used for decoration.
